Round One

Spite - Transhuman Serial Killer

Spite - 80

In Play: Safe House

Good Samaritan

Trash:

--------------------------------------------------------

Start of Turn: Useless healing.

Play a Card: Lab Raid! Demon's Kiss enters play.

End of Turn: On The Prowl destroys Good Samaritan, reveals Lost Child.

Spite deals Haka 4 energy damage.

Spite deals each non-villain target 1 infernal damage.

-------------------------------------------------------

Spite - 80

In Play: Safe House

"Demon's Kiss"

Lost Child

Trash: Lab Raid, Good Samaritan, On The Prowl

Effects: ST: If there are 5 Drug cards in play, flip Spite.

ST: Spite regains 7HP.

ET: Play the top card of the villain deck.

ET: Spite deals the hero target with the highest HP 4 energy damage.

ET: Spite deals each non-villain target 1 infernal damage.

Hero Start: That hero may have Spite deal them 4 melee damage. If they do, place Lost Child under the Safe House.

When Spite deals damage, he regains that much HP.

When Lost Child is destroyed, Spite regains 5HP.

Safe House, "Demon's Kiss" are indestructible.

Hero HP: Haka - 29, Dark Visionary - 24, Golem Unity - 24, The Wraith - 24, Team Leader Tachyon - 27

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Wraith's opening hand:  Grappling Hook, Infrared Eyepiece, Micro-Targeting Computer, Utility Belt.

phantaskippy:

Check that, I'm calling Dark Visionary.Playing her vs. a villain that completely neutralizes her base power should be fun.

I wouldn't say the power is completely useless; it means he plays one relevant card each turn instead of two.  It means she can't completely shut him down, but she can still help, if you don't have Mental Divergence or Foresight to make your Power phase useful somehow else.

Openeing hand:  Mass Levitation, Cerebral Hemorrhage, Decoy Projection, Brain Burn.Awesome.  Starting.  Hand.

That, on the other hand, is very typical of my own luck with Visi's starting hands (which is part of why I will never ever play Dark Visi, or likely any other promos that may turn up; Enlighten is just too good).  On the bright (or Dark, if she insists) side, at least you don't have two Brain Burns like I did in my last game with her.

Matchstickman:

Or a Meteor storm might come and save us!

Lab Raid and Mind-Fyre both make Environment cards unlikely to stick around and undesireable to keep.  If Meteor Storm does show up, one of us (probably Haka, he's the least likely to have other things to do when we're not dealing damage) would be reasonably well-advised to skip their turn destroying it, unless Visi has managed to Precog/Suggest the deck and then use Turmoil, so we're absolutely sure he won't bust out one of those cards.
